name: Vard Avard Landing
notes:
The landing area at Vardavard (Hemmat) spans approximately 60,000 m², providing a spacious and safe environment for paragliding pilots. Its flat and open surface offers ideal conditions for a controlled landing, even in moderate wind conditions, allowing pilots to manage wing handling and reduce speed safely.
The ample size of the landing zone also accommodates multiple landings simultaneously, minimizing the risk of collisions and providing a secure environment for groups of pilots.
